settings.headline:
Travel gently,
leave it better.
settings.copy: The best journeys are the ones that tread lightly. Terra Verde runs small-group expeditions through rainforests, fjords, and wild coastline — guided by naturalists, capped at ten guests, and designed to protect the places we explore. Every tour funds local conservation.

settings.title: Choose your
settings.intro: Three ways to get into the wild with Terra Verde — from a single unhurried day on the water to a week-long expedition into the backcountry.

design.title: Coastal rainforest walk
design.text: A full-day guided hike through old-growth rainforest and tidewater — boardwalks, giant cedars, and a picnic lunch on the inlet.

design.title: Kayak the quiet inlets
design.text: Paddle glassy channels in small kayaks with a naturalist. Sea lions, eagles, and the deep quiet of the fjords.

build.title: Two-day fjord expedition
build.text: Camp beneath old-growth forest, hike to a glacier viewpoint at dawn, and paddle back the way you came. Small camp, big silence.

build.title: Five-day backcountry traverse
build.text: A guided traverse of a protected coastal range — alpine lakes, wildlife, and nights under a sky with no light pollution.

launch.title: Private naturalist charter
launch.text: Book the whole boat or trail for your family, friends, or crew. Your pace, your dates, our guides and conservation commitment.

launch.title: Conservation & volunteer trips
launch.text: Combine travel with real restoration work — tree planting, trail repair, and habitat surveys alongside local scientists.

settings.title: Wild places,
settings.intro: We built Terra Verde around a simple rule: a tour should leave the place richer than it found it. Here's how we hold ourselves to it on every departure.

features.title: Small groups, always
features.text: We cap every expedition at ten guests. No crowding the boardwalks, no hordes of boats — just a handful of people moving quietly through wild country.

features.title: Naturalist guides
features.text: Every expedition is led by a certified naturalist — a biologist, ecologist, or long-time backcountry guide — who reads the landscape and shares what we're really looking at.

features.title: Conservation funding
features.text: A portion of every fare goes directly to local land trusts and restoration projects. Travelling with us funds the very habitats we visit.

features.title: Leave-no-trace by design
features.text: We pack out everything, camp on durable surfaces, and route around sensitive habitat. Our guides carry the gear and the training to do it right.

features.title: Carbon-neutral travel
features.text: Ground transport, boat fuel, and guide travel are offset through verified projects — and we favour electric and human-powered legs whenever the route allows.

features.title: Local, not generic
features.text: We work with the communities and scientists who know these places best. You're not getting a scripted tourist route — you're getting the insider's coast.

settings.title: From booking
settings.intro: A low-stress way to plan a wild trip. Here's what happens once you reserve a departure.

steps.title: Choose a departure
steps.text: Browse our calendar, pick a date and expedition, and reserve with a small deposit. Spaces are limited to ten, so they go quickly.

steps.title: We build your prep pack
steps.text: You'll receive a full packing list, fitness notes, and a briefing from your guide. We answer every question before you leave home.

steps.title: Meet your naturalist
steps.text: You'll meet your guide and small group at the trailhead or marina. Gear check, safety briefing, and the day's plan — then we move.

steps.title: Journey & give back
steps.text: Travel the coast with a certified naturalist. A share of your fare funds local conservation before you even return home.

settings.note: Every departure is fully carbon-neutral and leave-no-trace certified — our guarantee that your journey leaves the wild a little richer than it found it.

settings.title: The coast,
settings.intro: People tell us the same thing: they came for the scenery and left changed. Here's what a few guests had to say.

reviews.quote: I've done eco-tours on four continents and this was the most thoughtfully run of all of them. Ten of us, one naturalist who knew every tree and bird by name, and not a trace left behind. The fjord paddle at dawn was pure magic.
reviews.author: Amara N.

reviews.quote: As a conservation biologist I'm picky about who I trust with wild places. Terra Verde got every detail right — the leave-no-trace discipline, the local funding, the genuine science. I'll be back with my own research group.
reviews.author: Dr. Elias Roth

reviews.quote: We booked the private charter for our 20th anniversary. Small, unhurried, utterly beautiful. Our guide made us feel like the only people on the coast. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Priya & Marcus
